program.name: Athlete Express
program.subject: Athlete
program.blurb: Short athletic sessions: a few jumps, strength supersets, then balance.
program.about: Athletic training for a short slot. A few sets of jumps open each day, then supersets, squats and hinges one day and presses and rows the next, then a short balance block. Quick, explosive and done. Level II moves you one weight up and Level III adds reps.
program.split: Jumps, lower supersets & balance / jumps, upper supersets & balance, short
